title: AI agents are ready to shop. Some retailers are wary.
title_en: AI agents are ready to shop. Some retailers are wary.
author: The Verge AI
content_snippet: Using an AI agent to shop for you is a strange experience. Tech companies have marketed them as personal assistants - the democratizing of labor that ordinarily would only be available to the rich and powerful. In practice, at least for buying things, it's more like sending an anxious and apologetic teenager out to the store: They require an inordinate amount of instructions and specifications, run into technical problems regularly, and come back with solutions that are not exactly what you aske

paragraphs_zh: 专注于研发下一代卫星导航系统的太空初创企业 Xona Space Systems 宣布完成2.5亿美元的 D 轮融资，投后估值跃升至24.5亿美元，全力加速商业化高精度定位星座对传统政府 GPS 的补充与替代。
包括早期押注 SpaceX 的知名风投机构在内的资方一致认为，自动驾驶汽车、巡检无人机以及金融高频时钟同步对厘米级定位与高强抗干扰能力提出了刚性需求，这是传统中地球轨道（MEO）GPS 所无法满足的。
Xona 研发的低地球轨道（LEO）Pulsar 卫星网络发射功率较传统 GPS 强10倍以上，可实现亚厘米级精确实时解算，预计将于2027年完成全星座组网。

title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
title_en: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
author: THE DECODER
summary_en:
Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill.

title_en: GitLab patches a critical flaw that lets unauthenticated attackers run code on self-managed servers, affecting every release since 7.0 in 2014 (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)
author: The Hacker News
content_snippet:
GitLab released fixes on October 21 for a flaw that lets an attacker run code on a self-managed server without logging in, and it affects every version of the software going back to 7.0, released in 2014.

The fix matters even for administrators who patched nine days earlier: the October 12 update covered only versions 19.2 and later, and the new fixed versions sit one patch above it, so an instance updated then is in range again.

The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-110264, is rated 10.0 on the CVSS

author: Wired AI

Such share features usually involve clicking an option to create a unique URL that anyone can use to load a page hosting the content. Muse, which Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said last month was “built fro
summary_en: Security researchers from Claroc discovered a design flaw in Meta's AI app Muse, allowing attackers to easily enumerate shared conversation links. ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 首批关于苹果双屏折叠设备iPhone Duo的详细评测正式出炉。该设备在带来颇具创意的哑光内屏和多形态交互体验的同时，也暴露出外屏狭小、机身厚重笨拙、相机配置平庸以及高负载发热等明显短板。评测认为该产品是苹果近年来最大胆的重构尝试，但妥协过多，更接近尚未成熟的初代极客实验品。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Initial media reviews for Apple's fold-screen device iPhone Duo reveal an innovative matte inner screen alongside glaring flaws including a cramped outer display, excessive bulk, mediocre cameras, and thermal throttling. The device is characterized as an ambitious yet deeply compromised first-generation experiment primarily catering to early adopters.

title: Memo: eBay is cutting ~9% of its workforce to simplify operations and reallocate resources toward high-growth areas; eBay cut 6%, or ~800 staff, in February (Reuters)
title_en: Memo: eBay is cutting ~9% of its workforce to simplify operations and reallocate resources toward high-growth areas; eBay cut 6%, or ~800 staff, in February (Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: EBay (EBAY.O) will lay off about 9% of its workforce as the online marketplace looks to simplify operations and shift resources …
summary_en: E-commerce platform eBay announced in an internal memo that it will cut approximately 9% of its workforce, following a prior reduction of roughly 800 positions in February. The company cited the need to streamline corporate bureaucracy, rein in expenses, and reallocate capital toward higher-growth initiatives amidst softening retail demand.
title_zh: 注意：eBay将裁员约9%，以简化运营，并将资源重新分配给高增长领域；eBay 2月份裁员6%，约800人
summary_zh: 知名电商平台eBay宣布裁减约9%的员工以精简运营架构，年内第二度动刀重组预算资源
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】eBay管理层与全体员工在企业内部组织与全球电商市场运营：宣布裁减约9%员工，加速向高增长领域调整资源配置
【起因与机理】应对增长放缓与激烈竞争，降本增效并精简组织架构
【关键数据与实测】eBay宣布启动约9%人员比例的裁员计划。
【各方立场与态度】资金和资源将重新分配至回报率更高的新兴领域。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] eBay management and global staff: Slashing roughly 9% of staff to reallocate resources toward growth
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Battling sluggish top-line growth and trimming operational fat
[Key Metrics] eBay lays off ~9% of its global workforce in latest memo.
[Key Position & Outlook] Resources earmarked for reallocation to higher-growth business areas.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 电商巨头eBay通过内部备忘录宣布裁减约9%的全球员工，这是该公司继今年2月削减约800个岗位后的又一次规模化人员缩编。管理层表示，此次裁员旨在简化运营层级、控制固定成本支出，并将腾出的资本与人力资源重新倾斜至更具潜力的高增长核心业务。在跨境电商激烈竞争与存量博弈下，传统电商平台正被迫持续收缩组织冗余。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: E-commerce platform eBay announced in an internal memo that it will cut approximately 9% of its workforce, following a prior reduction of roughly 800 positions in February. The company cited the need to streamline corporate bureaucracy, rein in expenses, and reallocate capital toward higher-growth initiatives amidst softening retail demand.

title: The EU Commission launches a DSA probe into Booking Holdings' Booking.com to determine whether it is doing enough to combat fraudulent listings and phishing (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
title_en: The EU Commission launches a DSA probe into Booking Holdings' Booking.com to determine whether it is doing enough to combat fraudulent listings and phishing (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
author: Reuters
content_snippet: EU tech regulators will investigate whether online hotel reservation website Booking.com is doing enough to weed out fraudulent listings …
summary_en: The European Commission has initiated a formal probe under the Digital Services Act (DSA) against Booking Holdings' Booking.com. Regulators are assessing whether the platform took sufficient and rigorous measures to combat fraudulent lodging listings and phishing scams targeting consumers.
title_zh: 欧盟委员会对Booking Holdings旗下的Booking.com展开调查，以确定其在打击欺诈性房源和网络钓鱼方面是否做得足够。
summary_zh: 更多技术实测与行业影响持续跟踪
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】欧盟委员会与Booking Holdings在欧洲数字监管与在线旅游服务市场：对Booking.com展开DSA合规调查，核实打击虚假房源与网络钓鱼力度
【起因与机理】保护消费者免受平台诈骗危害，落实超大型在线中介平台的法律责任
【关键数据与实测】平台若违规最高可面临全球年营业额6%的重罚。
【各方立场与态度】核查重点聚焦平台对虚假房源发布及网络钓鱼的拦截力度。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] European Commission and Booking Holdings: Launched DSA compliance probe into fake listings and phishing defenses
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Enforcing safety protocols to safeguard consumers from online travel fraud
[Key Metrics] Potential penalties could reach up to 6% of global annual turnover.
[Key Position & Outlook] Scrutinizing measures against fraudulent listings and consumer phishing.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 欧盟委员会宣布依据《数字服务法案》（DSA）对在线旅游预订巨头Booking.com正式立案调查。监管机构将重点审查该平台是否履行法定责任，采取了充分有效的反制措施来遏制平台上的虚假酒店房源与网络钓鱼欺诈。随着欧洲对超大型在线平台的监管收紧，Booking若无法证明其算法与审核机制合规，将面临巨额反欺诈罚单风险。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The European Commission has initiated a formal probe under the Digital Services Act (DSA) against Booking Holdings' Booking.com. Regulators are assessing whether the platform took sufficient and rigorous measures to combat fraudulent lodging listings and phishing scams targeting consumers.
